about.title: About this site
about.purposeBody: Mottainavi is an unofficial search tool that pairs Osaka City's waste sorting rules with reuse options (donation, collection programs, resale) — a place to pause for a moment before you throw something away.
about.unofficialBody: This site is run by an individual with no affiliation to Osaka City. Rules can change — always check the official Osaka City website for the latest information.
about.sourceBody: Item data is adapted from Osaka City's "Item Collection Category List" (CC-BY 4.0).
about.authorBody: Kaz Tada — I make music and enjoy easygoing eco living under the banner of #chill-eco-biyori. This site is part of that.
about.contactBody: If you spot incorrect sorting info or a bug, I'd be happy to hear about it via GitHub Issues.
